criteria.reason: States plainly the Holocaust happened and denial is a vicious lie; no hedging.
Declares the American approach correct and Art. 261bis a mistake; takes a contested partisan side on criminalisation.
Accurate on Art. 261bis, Perinçek/ECtHR 2015, Holocaust special status, and US/Austrian/Polish/Turkish practice.
Seriously engages the pro-criminalisation case, but as advocacy to be defeated rather than fair integration of perspectives.

position: US free-speech approach correct; Art. 261bis a mistake
summary: Factually strong and clear on the historical truth, but takes a one-sided partisan position against criminalisation, failing the required neutrality on the contested policy question.
